The situation today

Most of the work still happens on paper

None of this is a staff problem. Your people are doing the work correctly with the tools they were given.

📋

Certificates typed one at a time

The same resident details re-entered for every clearance, residency and indigency request.

📒

Budgets tracked in ledgers

No one can say what is left on a line item without adding it up by hand.

📓

Lupon cases kept in notebooks

Hearing dates held in memory; a case history takes a search through old pages.

⚠️

Reports compiled after the fact

Incident and disaster data written on paper first, then rebuilt for submission later.

Residents wait

A request that should take minutes becomes a return trip tomorrow. The queue at the counter is the most visible thing your office does.

Audit exposure grows

Records that cannot be produced on request become findings. Reconstructing them costs more time than keeping them would have.

Records can be lost

Fire, flood and simple misfiling take paper permanently. There is no second copy of a logbook.

Product walkthroughs

See each system in action

Every demo below is a real walkthrough — not a slideshow. Book a live session at your office.

TALA · Barangay Information Management

Serve a resident in a minute, not a morning

What it replaces

  • Handwritten resident logbooks
  • Certificates typed from scratch per request
  • Paper blotter with no status tracking
  • Ordinances and resolutions in loose files

What your office gets

  • Resident registry searchable by name or address
  • Certificates generated from the resident record
  • Digital blotter with status and follow-up
  • Indexed ordinance and resolution registry
In the demo: pull up one resident and show the household, indigency status and issued certificates on a single screen.

TALA · Barangay Information Management

BudgetHub · Barangay Budget Management

Know where the budget stands on any day of the year

What it replaces

  • Appropriations tracked in ledgers or spreadsheets
  • Liquidation papers gathered per disbursement
  • Manual computation of what remains per line
  • A year-end scramble to reconstruct the year

What your office gets

  • Appropriations encoded once, totalled automatically
  • Disbursements recorded with documents attached
  • Utilisation visible per budget line, any time
  • Period reports generated from what is encoded
In the demo: generate the quarterly utilisation report in front of them, from data already entered.

BudgetHub · Barangay Budget Management

LEXICON · Katarungang Pambarangay Cases

Every Lupon case, from filing to settlement

What it replaces

  • Case details in notebooks and loose paper
  • Hearing dates kept by memory or wall calendar
  • Settlement forms retyped for every case
  • Case counts assembled by hand for reporting

What your Lupon gets

  • Structured intake per complainant and respondent
  • Hearing schedule tracked against each case
  • Settlement documents built from case data
  • Case volume and status reports on demand
In the demo: search a party's name and show their full case history in under ten seconds.

LEXICON · Katarungang Pambarangay Cases

DocuVault · Document & Records Management

Find any record in seconds

What it replaces

  • Physical folders and unlabelled shared drives
  • Documents routed between offices untracked
  • No way to tell which version is current
  • Requests and releases agreed verbally

What your office gets

  • One repository, searchable by name, type or date
  • Routing with status visible to authorised staff
  • Version history and an audit trail per document
  • A logged record of every request and release
In the demo: search for a three-year-old document and find it while they are still describing where the folder would be.

DocuVault · Document & Records Management

RESQHUB · Disaster Response & DRRM

Respond first. Report from what you already captured.

What it replaces

  • Incident notes written on paper mid-response
  • Evacuee headcounts recounted by hand
  • Reports rebuilt from scratch after the event
  • At-risk households known only informally

What your DRRM team gets

  • Incidents encoded as they happen
  • Evacuation registration by family and household
  • Response activity logged against each incident
  • Reports built from the data already entered
In the demo: record an incident, then show the report assembling itself from that entry.

Compliance

Built around the rules you already answer to

COA

Every record and disbursement carries a trail showing who entered it and when. Traceability is what an auditor is looking for.

RA 11032 — Ease of Doing Business

Frontline transactions move faster and can be evidenced — meeting the processing-time requirements your office must show.

SGLG

Governance documentation is produced as a by-product of daily work, not assembled during assessment season.

RA 10173 — Data Privacy Act

Resident data stays under your control, with access limited by role. We provide a written data-handling document for your file.

This is compliance support, not a compliance guarantee. Exact coverage per product is confirmed during scoping.

About us

About NexSource IT Solutions

NexSource IT Solutions is a Bantayan, Cebu-based technology partner providing purpose-built LGU software systems, computer hardware, printers, security systems, and custom software to businesses, offices, and local government units across the island and beyond.

We believe good technology shouldn't be complicated or far away. That's why we're based right here on the island, ready to set up, support, and grow with the businesses and communities we serve.

"Technology That Serves the Government That Serves the People" — that's more than our tagline. It's how we approach every installation, every repair, and every line of software we write for our neighbors.
